name: terraform-unresolved-first-category
body: Each unresolved record is emitted once per scan carrying the first category any site assigns to its name, whereas the PowerShell frontend keeps a fixed category precedence; the Terraform resolver's naming keeps external (a source string) and unknown (var.x, aws_vpc.main, a normalised path, a nameless key) names disjoint, so no name currently receives two categories. Upgrade to a fixed precedence if a later rule can give one name two categories or a targeted rescan shows a category differing from the full scan.
